<style id="smartmag-core-inline-css">
:root { --c-main: #038c33;
--c-main-rgb: 3,140,51;
--c-headings: #0d0d0d;
--c-post-meta: #383838; }
.s-light body { background-color: #fcfcfc; }
.s-dark body { background-color: #0d0d0d; }
.smart-head-main { --main-width: 1300px; }
.smart-head-row > .inner { max-width: min(1300px, 100%); margin: 0 auto; }
.smart-head-main { --c-shadow: rgba(10,10,10,0.03); }
.smart-head-main .smart-head-top { background-color: #038c33; }
.smart-head-main .smart-head-mid { --head-h: 130px; background-color: #ffffff; border-bottom-width: 3px; border-bottom-color: #f2e205; }
.smart-head-main .smart-head-bot { --head-h: 57px; }
.s-dark .smart-head-main .smart-head-bot,
.smart-head-main .s-dark.smart-head-bot { background-color: #006db9; }
.smart-head-main .smart-head-bot { border-bottom-width: 2px; border-bottom-color: #69abce; }
.navigation-main .menu > li > a { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.navigation-main { --nav-items-space: 12px; }
.s-light .navigation-main { --c-nav: #0f0f0f; --c-nav-hov: #038c33; }
.s-light .navigation { --c-nav-blip: #0a0a0a; --c-nav-drop-bg: #f2b705; --c-nav-drop-hov-bg: #038c33; --c-nav-drop: #0a0a0a; --c-nav-drop-hov: #ffffff; }
.smart-head-mobile .smart-head-mid { background-color: #ffffff; }
.s-dark .smart-head-mobile .smart-head-mid,
.smart-head-mobile .s-dark.smart-head-mid { border-top-color: #f4f4f4; }
.smart-head-mobile .smart-head-mid { border-bottom-width: 2px; border-bottom-color: #f2e205; }
.off-canvas { background-color: #231773; }
.smart-head-mobile { --c-search-icon: #038c33; }
.smart-head-mobile .search-icon:hover { color: #f2e205; }
.smart-head-mobile { --c-hamburger: #038c33; }
.smart-head-mobile .offcanvas-toggle:hover { --c-hamburger: #f2e205; }
.trending-ticker .heading { color: #ffffff; }
.s-light .block-wrap.s-dark { --c-post-meta: var(--c-contrast-450); }
.read-more-btn { color: #ffffff; background-color: #038c33; }
@media (min-width: 941px) and (max-width: 1200px) { .navigation-main .menu > li > a { font-size: calc(10px + (14.5px - 10px) * .7); } }
